design_context.theme: Dark, Bold & Sporty Craft Beer Tavern
design_context.brand_identity: Belly and the Beer - 21 Elgin Street, Soho, Hong Kong
design_context.emotional_tone: High-octane athletic pub competition, warm craft beer culture, sharp tactical precision

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tight
scale.subtitle: text-base sm:text-lg font-medium text-amber-400/90 tracking-wide uppercase

spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_mode: MODE B: Tactical High Density & Mode A Hybrid

key_features_to_build: Public Landing & League Overview: Hero with venue branding (Belly and the Beer, 21 Elgin St, HK), timeline (Sep 20 - Dec 27), entry fee breakdown ($100 early by Sep 12 / $200 late), prizes, and rules summary.

Public Standings & Leaderboard: Overall standings + Monthly standings switcher, top 3 trophy callout, stats breakdown (Matches Played, Medley Wins, Count Up Wins, Half It Wins, Total Points max 15/day).
Season Schedule & Timeline: 15 weeks of Sunday matchdays (3:00 PM - 6:00 PM), filter by week or player, show match status & pairing.
Interactive Match Score Calculator & Match Day Rules Widget: Clear visual explainer for Medley (2-0 = 3pts, 2-1 = 2pts), Count Up (+1pt), Half It (+1pt), Bullseye throw for first turn.
Player Registration & Entry Fee Tracking: Public sign-up form with tier calculation ($100 early / $200 late based on registration date), payment tracking indicator.
Admin Dashboard (Google Auth Simulated/Mocked or Integrated): Score entry tool (3 matches x 3 games per match per player per day), Player approval & fee management, Schedule manager.

component_design_rules.header: Sticky Glassmorphic Header (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0F1115]/80 border-b border-white/10 z-50`). Never transparent without blur.
component_design_rules.cards: Dark tavern slate surfaces (`bg-[#161B22] border border-white/10 hover:border-amber-500/40 transition-all duration-200 rounded-xl p-6`).
component_design_rules.buttons_primary: Pill or sleek rounded rectangular CTA (`bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-6 py-3 shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20 active:scale-95 transition-all`).
component_design_rules.buttons_secondary: Bordered dark button (`bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-white font-semibold border border-white/20 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg transition-all`).
component_design_rules.tables_and_leaderboards: High-density tactical tables with rank badges (Gold #1, Silver #2, Bronze #3), subtle grid lines, hover highlighting, and sortable columns.
component_design_rules.data_testid_requirement: EVERY interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, filters, table rows, cards) MUST include a clear `data-testid` attribute (e.g. data-testid='admin-score-entry-submit-button', data-testid='standings-monthly-tab').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Javascript (.js / .jsx) components as configured in the frontend.
Integrate Lucide icons or Phosphor icons for dart, beer, calendar, trophy, shield, clock, location, user, check, and edit icons.
Ensure all forms use controlled state with toast feedback via Sonner (`import { toast } from 'sonner'`).
Make sure every interactive element has `data-testid` for automated end-to-end verification.
Include mock seed data for 12+ players, multi-week match histories, and realistic dart scores so the standings look rich immediately.
Provide a toggle or quick-switcher between Public View and Admin Dashboard for seamless testing.
